name: China
summary: East Asian nation spanning Tibetan Plateau headwaters, fertile alluvial river basins, and dense coastal industrial agglomerations. Leads global absolute renewable installations and solar manufacturing while managing high coal capacity and winter airshed particulate concentrations.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 6.20x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); down 42% from 2013 peak due to Clean Air Action Plan controls.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; set all-time national record high annual mean temperature in 2023.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Accelerated warming rate across northern and western continental interior basins over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 31.9% share of global territorial fossil emissions; world leader in industrial output and power generation.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Surpasses EU average per capita emissions; reflects intensive heavy industrial and cement manufacturing output.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Substantial forest expansion under the Three-North Shelterbelt and national afforestation programs.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Accounts for 37% of global solar and wind electricity generation; world leader in total renewable capacity.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 152 people/km²; urban population fraction is 65.2%.
